items.summary: Financial recommendation: maintain containment-only execution and reject new spend, forecasts, prototypes, and production admissions this cycle. Revenue evidence is limited to Amazon data for 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission, all income assigned to aggregate tracking_id "other" and therefore unattributed. Site revenue, contribution margin, ROI, and causal lift are unsupported. AI usage for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-30 is 5,522 calls, 234 errors, and $997.51762695 recorded cost; this is approximately $0.18 per call and $199.50 per proven outcome if divided mechanically across 5 proven outcomes, but neither figure is a causal unit-cost measure. Infrastructure, hosting, domain, labor, marketing, and other operating costs are absent, so total spend, contribution margin, budget exposure, and break-even are not calculable. Preserve the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA experiment only after capacity clears; its 2026-09-21 baseline is 61 affiliate clicks, 0 ordered items, and $0 site-attributed commission. Do not treat impressions, sessions, clicks, conversions, proposals, or shipped work as revenue or profit forecasts.

CFO rejects the retained CRO control-plane and AI-guardrail proposals as implementation work this cycle because delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots and existing records already support a report-only finance assessment. The minimum missing measurements are: a common period-aligned revenue export, site/content-level tracking for every commission row, infrastructure and vendor invoices or cost ledger, labor allocation basis, and a join between AI calls, verified outputs, and measured outcomes. No banking, billing, contract, or spending action is authorized.
